drhp.business: The Company has evolved from a traditional metal trading business into one of India's emerging aluminium recycling and value-added aluminium products companies. drhp.one_liner: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited is a specialised processor of aluminium scrap into value-added aluminium alloys and aluminium de-ox products for diverse industrial applications.

risks.note: Aluminium and scrap prices are sensitive to energy costs, global demand, China's production trends, inventory levels, trade policies and geopolitical developments, exposing margins to commodity swings.
The metal recycling business requires significant scrap procurement funded through fund-based and non-fund-based credit arrangements, making efficient working capital management critical.
The Company's operations depend on continued availability of aluminium scrap for processing into alloys and de-ox products.
Demand from automotive, steel, electrical transmission, construction and other end-user industries can vary with their own cyclicality.
Large industrial customers, including automotive OEMs, require consistent quality and reliable delivery; failure to meet stringent specifications could affect customer relationships.
The Company must comply with increasingly stringent environmental regulations applicable to metal recycling and processing operations.
Company performance is influenced by aluminium prices and scrap procurement cost, creating margin sensitivity to commodity price movements.
The Company is exposed to volatility in foreign exchange movement as a threat alongside aluminium price and scrap availability risk.
